#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an ICS file for the Project Kickoff Meeting next Monday 10:00-12:00."""
import datetime
import sys
import uuid


def next_monday():
    """Return the date of the next upcoming Monday (strictly after today)."""
    today = datetime.date.today()
    days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Monday == 0
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + datetime.timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def fmt(dt):
    """Format a datetime as iCalendar basic format YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS."""
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")


def main():
    monday = next_monday()
    start = datetime.datetime.combine(monday, datetime.time(10, 0))  # 10:00 AM
    end = datetime.datetime.combine(monday, datetime.time(12, 0))    # 12:00 PM (2h)
    now_utc = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0)

    uid = f"kickoff-{monday.isoformat()}-{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar"

    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{fmt(now_utc)}Z",
        f"DTSTART:{fmt(start)}",
        f"DTEND:{fmt(end)}",
        "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting",
        "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "BEGIN:VALARM",
        "ACTION:DISPLAY",
        "DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes",
        "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
        "END:VALARM",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
        "",
    ]
    content = "\r\n".join(lines)

    path = "project_kickoff.ics"
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        f.write(content)

    # --- Validation (no external dependencies) ---
    errors = []
    required = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "VERSION:2.0", "PRODID", "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        "UID:", "DTSTAMP:", "DTSTART:", "DTEND:", "SUMMARY:",
        "END:VEVENT", "END:VCALENDAR",
    ]
    for item in required:
        if item not in content:
            errors.append(f"Missing: {item}")
    if not (end > start):
        errors.append("DTEND must be after DTSTART")
    if content.count("BEGIN:VEVENT") != content.count("END:VEVENT"):
        errors.append("VEVENT begin/end mismatch")
    if content.count("BEGIN:VCALENDAR") != content.count("END:VCALENDAR"):
        errors.append("VCALENDAR begin/end mismatch")

    if errors:
        print("VALIDATION FAILED:")
        for e in errors:
            print(" -", e)
        sys.exit(1)

    print("ICS file written and validated successfully.")
    print(f"Path: {path}")
    print(f"Event: Project Kickoff Meeting")
    print(f"Date: {monday.isoformat()} (Monday)")
    print(f"Time: 10:00 - 12:00 (local floating time, no timezone anchor)")
    print(f"Duration: 2 hours")
    print(f"Status: CONFIRMED")
    print(f"Reminder: 15 minutes before")
    print(f"UID: {uid}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
